candidates.title: Architecting Long-Context LLM Acceleration with Packing-Prefetch Scheduler and Ultra-Large Capacity On-Chip Memories
candidates.reason: packing-prefetch schedulerと512MB級BEOL on-chip memoryをco-designし、long-context KV transferをcomputeと重畳。Llama3.1-8Bでdecode 8.06x、overall latency 1.83x、multi-request throughput 1.7-2.4xを報告し、prefetchとmemory hierarchyのhardware/runtime接点として有用。

candidates.title: InfiniGen: Efficient Generative Inference of Large Language Models with Dynamic KV Cache Management
candidates.reason: offloading-based inferenceで次layerに重要なKV tokenをminimal rehearsalにより予測し、必要KVだけを選択的に転送するdynamic KV management。長文生成のhost-device KV traffic削減系統の重要な欠落候補。

discovery_stats.axis: KV prefetch・cache admission・I/O scheduling・memory hierarchy
discovery_stats.query_summary: cache prefetch、cache admission、storage/I-O scheduling、KV transfer overlapへ検索窓を移動。Asynchronous KV L2 prefetch、CacheFlow、SwiftCache、Tutti、DuoServe-MoE、Apt-Serve、Cascade、cache-resident inference、flow-control scheduling等の既収録をidentity snapshotで事前除外し、provider検索窓終了時に残った2件を評価して採用した。
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: 最新canonical inventoryを再評価し、50超ならoverflow research、未満なら未走査の引用関係/隣接systemsへ継続
